content.summary: Stocks are on pace for a third consecutive day of declines amid a pullback in Treasury bond yields that could test investors betting on deeper Federal Reserve interest rate cuts over the coming months.  The S&P 500 was down 0.3% in Thursday trading, while the Nasdaq Composite was falling 0.2%.  The Commerce Department on Thursday published revised gross domestic product data that showed the U.S. economy expanded at a faster-than-expected 3.8% year-over-year clip over the second quarter.
